spans.s:
Dhaivara means a ‘fisherman,’ as a member of a caste, in the list of victims at the Puruṣamedha, or ‘human sacrifice,’ in the yajurveda. Cf. Dhīvara.
Foot notes This seems to be shown by the patronymic form, ‘descendant of a dhīvara.’
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxx. 16; Tait tirīya brāhmaṇa, iii. 4, 15, 1.
